connection.description: Protocol to talk to the phone, gammurc(5): at for most modems, or e.g. at115200, fbus, bluephonet.

debuglevel.description: Debug level: the sum of the flags to enable (1 basic, 2 gammu library, 4 SQL queries); 0 is off.

errorsmspath.description: Where messages that failed to send are moved (files service).

inboxpath.description: Where received messages are stored (files service).

logfile.description: File SMSD logs to, or the special value syslog.

outboxpath.description: Where messages to send are queued (files service).

port.description: Device the phone/modem is attached to (e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0) — the shipped /dev/null is a placeholder ("Please configure this!"), gammurc(5).

sentsmspath.description: Where sent messages are moved (files service).

service.description: SMSD service storing the messages: files, null (none), or sql (database, see Driver).
